SUMMARY
------------------------------------------
Product design leader with 10+ years in developer tools, leading 0→1 initiatives and end-to-end design programs in high-tech environments. Product-minded and execution-focused, setting direction, aligning cross-functional teams, and translating complex technical contexts into simple, scalable workflows, driving measurable outcomes (adoption, conversion, usability) from strategy through delivery.

EXPERIENCE

Docker.com — Remote
Staff Product Designer / AI and Agentic Flows UX Lead | 2023 - Present
  * Designed and owned Docker AI features (Model Runner, MCP Toolkit, Docker AI Agent) from early concept to shipped product; scaled MCP adoption from 0 to tens of thousands of developers within the first quarter after launch and grew the AI agent from 0 to thousands of daily active users. Improved upgrade UX (upgrade flows and in-product prompts), driving a ~19% lift in Basic → paid plan upgrades.
  * Redesigned Docker CLI to improve usability for millions of developers, simplifying onboarding and everyday workflows; improved CLI OAuth flows by 17%.
  * Served as interim PM across CLI/GUI/AI, shaping the roadmap and prioritizing UX delivery; defined the foundations of the Docker TUI (Text-based UI) and led cross-product integration of TUI features, taking it from concept to active implementation.
  * Built functional proof-of-concepts (beyond prototypes) combining LLM tools (Claude, v0, Lovable) with the CLI and developer workflows, accelerating validation and driving adoption in beta programs.
